messages:
Aisha: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-077. I grouped the action items into one epic so we can avoid duplicate work. Epic: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-5998. Need owners + ETA + RACI entries. TL;DR items:
- circuit-breaker tuning + staggered rollback plan
- update postmortem doc + closure notes
- month-end recurrence RCA (telemetry + synthetic)
- alert rule: reduce noisy pageflips

matt: I can take circuit-breaker tuning and the staggered rollback play. Will create a subtask and set ETA: 2 weeks. Need @Priya for canary window signoff.

Priya: Ack I can sign off on canary windows. For rollback plan please include a step that updates the oncall runbook entry and add a short checklist.

oliver: I'll own the month-end recurrence RCA. Plan: run synthetic load against the job schedule, correlate with KV eviction logs, and propose mitigations. ETA: 10 business days.

Aisha: Thanks. For RACI, propose: matt (R), Aisha (A), Priya (C), oliver (I) for the circuit-breaker item. For the RCA item: oliver (R), Aisha (A), infra-team (C), matt (I). Speak now if objections.

matt: Fine with that. I'll draft the RACI in the subtask description.

sre-bot: Created JIRA RI-5999 "Circuit-breaker tuning + staggered rollback" assigned to matt. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-5999

sre-bot: Created JIRA RI-6000 "Month-end recurrence RCA: telemetry + synthetic" assigned to oliver. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-6000

Aisha: Priya, can you claim the postmortem document update? We need closure notes, timeline, and the actions table. ETA: EOD next Tue.

Priya: I'll take it. Will update the doc and add the 'owner-of-record' field on each action. Also will add a handoff note to the oncall-week-14 rotation so next oncall knows the context.

matt: Quick copy of the alert rule I want tuned, feel free to paste into the ticket:

```
alert: HighPageflipRate
expr: sum(rate(pageflip_errors_total[5m])) by (shard) > 50
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High pageflip error rate on {{ $labels.shard }}"
```

Aisha: Nice, please add current false-positive count and an estimate of expected pages per shard. We want to avoid paging for transient spikes.

oliver: If RCA shows correlated KV eviction spikes, tag RI-6000 with 'kv-eviction' and 'dedicated-capacity' so infra scheduling can prioritize.

Priya: Will do. Also adding a recurring biweekly checkpoint on the epic until we have 2 consecutive month-end windows without regression.

matt: I'll include a short verification SOP in RI-5999 and a checklist for the canary window.

Aisha: Great. Please drop an emoji when your subtask is linked in the epic so I can compile the tracker for the weekly ops review. :spiral_calendar:

matt: :white_check_mark:

oliver: :thumbsup:

Priya: :heavy_check_mark:
